_comment: Offscreen-QPA screen configuration for two consumers.
test_control_center_controller: screenOf resolves an item's window screen
and falls back to the primary; with one output those are the same pointer,
so the resolution branch could be deleted with the suite still green.
test_socket_popout_transport: the production default screen-name resolver
returns QScreen::name(), and the transport refuses an empty name. The bare
offscreen platform names its screen "", so without named outputs that
resolver could only ever take the refusal path.
ControlCenterController::screenOf falls back to the primary screen when it
cannot resolve one from the item. With a single output the resolved answer
and the fallback are the same pointer, so the resolution branch could be
deleted outright with the suite still green. A second output makes the two
distinguishable. The offscreen platform plugin accepts this file via
